summary: Iteration 3: tested new Sales Agent feature set — AgentLeads page, AI Digest card, GPS check-in on QuickLogModal (site_visit only), monthly Leaderboard for admin/manager, /api/agent/* endpoints. Backend: 23/23 pytest tests passed covering 3-step auth (admin/manager/rep/provider), /api/agent/dashboard, /api/agent/leads (with stage/provider_type/last_touched/q filters + pagination), /api/agent/leads/map, /api/agent/quick-log (incl. gps persistence on site_visit, auto-advance kyc_collected→kyc_submitted with DB persistence verified via GET /contacts/:id, follow-up task creation), /api/agent/digest (success=true with Claude text + stats), /api/agent/targets, /api/agent/leaderboard (admin & manager allowed, sales_rep 403, provider 403). Frontend: 16/17 playwright checks passed — Rohan logs in and lands on /agent; sidebar shows exactly [My Day, My Leads, My Pipeline, My Activity Log, My Tasks] with NO Leaderboard; AgentDigest card renders, clicking 'Generate today's digest' fills digest-content; /agent/leads loads with search + 3 filters + clickable rows that navigate to /contacts/:id; QuickLogModal shows GPS block ONLY for site_visit activity type and hides it when switching back to cold_call; admin login lands on / with Leaderboard in sidebar and /agent/leaderboard renders the ranked table; sales rep is correctly redirected away from /agent/leaderboard; provider redirected from /agent/leads. The 1 FAIL is a REAL product bug — provider accessing /agent is NOT redirected (only the page sub-routes are guarded), so AgentDashboard mounts under provider's Layout, fires /api/agent/dashboard + /api/agent/leads/map which return 403, and CRA dev overlay throws an uncaught AxiosError runtime-error screen.

integration_issues.issue: /agent route in /app/frontend/src/App.js line 69 is wrapped in <RequireAuth> only (no internalOnly). Providers landing on /agent are NOT redirected to /provider; AgentDashboard mounts, fires GET /api/agent/dashboard + /api/agent/leads/map → both 403, surfacing an uncaught AxiosError runtime-error overlay. Both other agent routes (/agent/leads, /agent/leaderboard) are correctly guarded.

action_items: Add internalOnly to the /agent route guard in /app/frontend/src/App.js line 69: change <Route path="/agent" element={<RequireAuth><AgentDashboard /></RequireAuth>} /> → <Route path="/agent" element={<RequireAuth internalOnly><AgentDashboard /></RequireAuth>} />. This will redirect providers to /provider, matching how /agent/leads and the other internal pages are guarded.
critical_code_review_comments: /agent route lacks internalOnly guard — see action item above. One-line fix.

AgentDashboard does not defensively swallow 403s from /api/agent/dashboard or /api/agent/leads/map — when an unauthorized user briefly mounts the component (e.g. during a redirect), CRA's dev runtime-error overlay renders. Consider try/catch in load() to silently bail rather than letting axios errors bubble.

server.py is now 1949 lines (was 1336 last iteration) — agent endpoints are inlined alongside provider/contact/auth/seed. Strongly recommend splitting into routers/agent.py, routers/provider.py, routers/auth.py, db/seed.py before further growth.

/api/agent/digest depends on EMERGENT_LLM_KEY + emergentintegrations. The graceful fallback (success:false, text=context) is correct, but during this test run AI returned success:true so the fallback path was not exercised in production traffic — fine since fallback logic is simple.

Mock OTP message still exposes the OTP value in /api/auth/send-otp response ('use 123456 for testing') — already flagged in iter-2, still present. Acceptable while mock=true but must be gated behind a dev flag before live OTP provider.
/api/agent/quick-log persists gps as a free-form dict — no validation on lat/lng numeric range or required keys. Pydantic GPS sub-model would be safer.

rca of the issue: Routing definition in App.js line 69 omitted the internalOnly flag (compare with neighbouring lines 70-71 which DO have internalOnly/adminOnly). Because <RequireAuth> without any flag only checks user!=null, a provider_owner passes through and mounts AgentDashboard. AgentDashboard's useEffect immediately calls GET /api/agent/dashboard and GET /api/agent/leads/map — both gated by is_sales_rep() server-side — which return 403. The axios errors are not caught in the component, so React's dev-mode error overlay surfaces. Fix is one line; after fix, retest by logging in as provider and navigating to /agent — expect Navigate to /provider and no overlay. Also recommend wrapping AgentDashboard.load() in try/catch as defence-in-depth so transient 403s during redirect chains never throw.
